instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL: framer-motion, lucide-react, sonner, date-fns, clsx, tailwind-merge
THEME: Configure tailwind.config.js to use the custom color palette defined in 'colors'. Ensure 'dark' class is applied to HTML/Body by default or via a ThemeProvider.
COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn UI as a base but HEAVILY override styles to match the 'Nocturnal Clarity' aesthetic. No default white backgrounds.
FORMS: Split the 'New Report' form into a Multi-step Wizard. Do not dump all inputs on one page.
IMAGES: Use the provided Unsplash URLs for the Landing Page and Dashboard backgrounds. Use 'object-cover' and 'brightness-50' for background images to ensure text readability.
MESSAGING: Build the in-ticket chat to look like a modern messenger (e.g., iMessage/WhatsApp style bubbles) but with the app's dark theme.
NOTIFICATIONS: Use 'sonner' for all success/error toasts. Position bottom-right on desktop, top-center on mobile.
TESTING: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards).
CRITICAL: Do not use gradients for backgrounds of cards. Use flat dark colors with subtle borders.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
